summary: We are looking for a highly skilled Frontend (Angular) Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be proficient in the full software development life cycle, including designing, coding, testing, and managing applications.
responsibilities: Design, develop, test, and manage various web applications.
Collaborate with the engineering and product teams to build high-performance solutions.
Ensure the quality and security of applications by following coding standards and best practices.
Develop automated tests and conduct performance tuning.
Maintain and improve existing codebases and peer-review code changes.
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders.
required_skills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a relevant field.
1 to 4 years of experience working with frontend technologies.
Strong experience developing web-based applications using Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Proficiency in working with REST APIs and state management solutions (e.g., NgRx).
Hands-on experience with Bootstrap and responsive design.
Familiarity with the full software development life cycle.
Experience in troubleshooting, debugging, and optimizing application performance.
Strong communication skills, analytical thinking, and problem-solving ability.
